Ready to kickstart your workday in a dynamic environment? As a warehouse worker, you play a crucial role in the logistics process. Do you have experience in logistics as an order picker, or would you like to gain it? Then this is the job for you! In this role as an order picker, you are jointly responsible for ensuring that supermarkets are stocked with all kinds of products. Before the products reach the stores, you have already handled them in the distribution center.In this position, you will be involved in various all-round logistics activities. For instance, using a voice-picking system, you will collect specific products and quantities to be stocked for the different supermarkets. You pack the goods neatly to prevent damage, after which the full roll containers are collected and delivered to the dispatch department. Although the orders are collected using the order picking truck, the products must be placed on the truck by hand. Therefore, it is important that you are capable of performing physical work. What kind of products and weights are we talking about? This warehouse contains fast-moving goods, such as wine, crates of beer, cat food, chips, and best-selling (and therefore fast-moving) hand soap dispensers. Both part-time and full-time are possible for this position; a weekend day (Saturday/Sunday) is a requirement.- You speak fluent Dutch or English- You have experience in logistics as an order picker or would like to gain this experience- You are able to perform physical work- Available for at least one day during the weekend
